name: Nova
tagline: A simple dashboard for businesses to invoice and accept cryptocurrency payments.
problem: Crypto payment tools are expensive and complicated for businesses.
solution: A full-stack app for invoices, payment tracking and transaction history on Solana.
demo_moment: Team-described: create an invoice and watch its status update.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Solana” among 112 submissions.
Hides blockchain complexity behind familiar invoicing.

lessons: Wrap new rails in an old workflow.
